# MESH_OPERATOR

The mesh operator's CRDs are registered, and the router its resources attach to.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `meshOperator`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.meshOperator`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

## Fields

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| crdKinds | list of string |
| namespace | kubernetes name (DNS-1123 label) |
| routerRef | null or record { name, namespace } |
